metadata.title: Platform Time Availability and Resilience

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring time services remain available, resilient, and predictable under failure conditions.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Redundancy, fault tolerance, and recovery mechanisms for platform time services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern ensuring trusted time does not become a single point of failure for the platform.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Time availability depends on bounded drift and controlled correction behavior to prevent cascading failures.

metadata.remarks: Platform Time Availability and Resilience defines expectations for redundancy, failover, and degradation behavior of time services. It ensures time failures are explicit, bounded, and recoverable rather than silent or destabilizing.

components.title: Time Source Redundancy
components.description: Ensures multiple independent time sources are available to prevent loss of authoritative time.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Denial of service or integrity failure caused by reliance on a single time source.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Redundant infrastructure to preserve service availability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Redundant time sources are used to support high availability.

components.title: Time Service Failover
components.description: Defines how platform systems fail over when primary time services become unavailable.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Integrity degradation caused by unpredictable or unmanaged time service failure.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Deterministic failover behavior preserving system stability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time services fail over in a predictable manner that preserves system integrity.

components.title: Time Degraded Mode Behavior
components.description: Defines acceptable platform behavior when authoritative time cannot be maintained.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Subtle trust failure caused by systems operating on inconsistent or frozen time.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Graceful degradation preserving partial trust guarantees.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Degraded time behavior is defined to support continuity of operations.
